title: Sunset cruise peaceful cruise
text:
It was a beautiful peaceful experience. I loved the humus! Marcello was a Jack of all trade. Captain cook bartender mate and history buff. Music was 🔥 🎶 👌🏽 How did you arrange the most perfect night?  Thank you
Highly recommended.
author: debcaraquin

title: Best excursion ever!
text: This was an amazing experience.  The Spanish guitar was perfection.  We chose to have dinner on the boat and the personal touches from the chef were amazing.  I have never had food like this before.  Top notch!
author: Pamela_H

title: Must Go!!!
text: We had a fantastic time. Cristobal, our captain and Carlos, our guitar player were amazing. They made us feel welcome and took excellent care of us on our sunset cruise. We would definitely go again and would love to see the sunrise cruise too.
author: Maria_F

title: Relaxing and Entertaining
text: If you want an enjoyable experience, this is the one for you!  To be out on the sea with the beautiful blue waters and have the sweet music of a guitar player, is so relaxing.  Our tour guide shared some information while we enjoyed tapas and wine.  It was a great way to watch the sun begin to set in the horizon!
author: Linda_A

title: Beautiful Experience
text: Boat Captain and entertainer were very friendly. Beautiful experience with my girlfriend on Valentine’s Day. The boat ride was smooth and the views were beautiful. True couples experience with a touch of natures beautiful waters.
author: Z8283ULwendyr

title: Our sunset cruise in Barcelona
text: What an exceptional tour, our guide Manuel was brilliant, very friendly and made everyone feel welcomed. Our guitarist was outstanding (cannot recall his name). We would highly recommend this cruise with Manuel.
author: N4174KIeddieg

title: Beautiful sunset and relaxing few hours
text: Beautiful experience, small group of people and plenty space to relax, mice drinks and snacks, plenty refills, we had a great time, our captain  was great and the guitar playing in the background was very nice
author: Teo_B

title: Yo ho ho and a bottle of cava!
text: The captain made the best out of our cruise, given there were clouds and no sun.  Pablo is an amazing guitarist and was even able to play in the most difficult and choppy waters while we were almost on our side in the sail boat.  Marcello was an amazing Captain, full of great sea stories and entertaining anecdotes about the area, the World Cup teams, and adventures in the area.  We hit the breakwater as a bunch of first time sailors and it was exciting to cut through the white caps with all but one of the crew on the starboard side as she held steady and fast around the harbor to berth shift t
author: fourcookiesrwe

title: Fun little sunset sail
text: Great captain & great live Spanish guitar! Lively seas made for a fun ride with lots of laughs while the cava flowed. Snacks were light but nice. For a great view of the city from the water, this was an intimate way to meet a few fellow travellers & make a memory. Book it!
author: Gwynne_M

title: Really nice experience and we very much enjoyed Manual, he’s a very good skipper.
text:
We really enjoyed our cruise along the waterfront with Manual. Professional operation with very personable staff who made sure that we had a great time. 
The access to the boat was a bit convoluted due to construction but the staff made sure to communicate that, which we appreciated.
author: YouthinAsia
